title: Totalizing a homogeneous sheaf algebra
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme and $C=(C_n)_{n\ge0}$ a family of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules with a commutative unital graded sheaf algebra structure $D$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. There exist a sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_Z$-algebras $A$ [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf] and module maps $j_n:C_n\to A$ whose cofan is a coproduct [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each open $V\subseteq Z$, $a\in C_m(V)$ and $b\in C_n(V)$ one has $j_m(a)j_n(b)=j_{m+n}(D_{m,n}(a,b))$. For $r\in\mathcal O_Z(V)$ one has $j_0(D_{\rm unit}(r))=\rho_A(r)$, where $\rho_A:\mathcal O_Z\to A$ is its structure map. No closed immersion, ideal, affine chart or representative formula is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.GradedSheafAlgebra.exists_total to the same family C and homogeneous algebra D, obtaining A, the inclusions j, their colimit witness, multiplication compatibility and scalar compatibility. Keep the witnesses and the colimit and scalar clauses. For the multiplication clause reorder the quantified variables from V,m,n to m,n,V and use symmetry of the supplied equality. The input hypotheses and universes are identical; no quasi-coherence, finiteness or nonemptiness is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_gradedSheafAlgebra_totalization {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (C : ℕ → Z.Modules) (D : GradedSheafAlgebra C) :
    ∃ (A : Z.CommAlgebraSheaf) (j : ∀ n, C n ⟶ A.toModule),
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk A.toModule j)) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (V : Z.Opens)
        (a : (C m).val.obj (op V)) (b : (C n).val.obj (op V)),
        (@id (A.right.obj.obj (op V)) ((j m).val.app (op V) a)) *
          (@id (A.right.obj.obj (op V)) ((j n).val.app (op V) b)) =
          (j (m + n)).val.app (op V) (D.mul m n V a b)) ∧
      (∀ (V : Z.Opens) (r : Γ(Z, V)),
        (j 0).val.app (op V) (D.unit.val.app (op V) r) = A.hom.hom.app (op V) r)
